components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            Optional honorific title of the pet owner, one of 'MR', 'MRS', 'MS'
            or 'DR'. When present it drives the derived 'salutation'. Stored and
            returned as given.
          type: string
          example: 'DR'
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on input for backward
            compatibility (the flat form) and always returned. When structured
            address fields are supplied it is the composed, normalized value: the
            normalized 'addressLine1', with a single space and the normalized
            'addressLine2' appended when an 'addressLine2' is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. LIBERTY STREET'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. Preferred
            over the flat 'address' when present; normalized (trim, collapse
            whitespace, upper-case, expand street-type abbreviations) like the flat
            address. An owner is valid when it supplies EITHER a non-blank
            'addressLine1' or the flat 'address', plus a city.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal address
            (e.g. unit or apartment). Normalized like 'addressLine1' and, when
            present, appended to the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            Optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must be valid for
            the owner's city per the fixed region table (Sydney->NSW 2000-2099,
            Melbourne->VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane->QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region
            accepts any 4-digit postcode. Out-of-range postcodes are rejected with 400. When
            omitted the owner is still accepted. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to E.164:
            a leading '+' and country code are kept when present, otherwise country code
            '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits;
            spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped and the result must have 8 to 15 digits
            after the '+'. The E.164 value is stored and returned (e.g. '0412 345 678' ->
            '+61412345678').
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            Optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' form. When
            omitted on create it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            Optional date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' form. When
            present it is stored and returned as given and drives the derived 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only flag set on create to acknowledge that this owner shares a
            household with an existing owner. The household is keyed on last name and
            postcode, so owners with the same last name and postcode share a household
            automatically. When omitted or false, creating a second owner in an existing
            household is rejected with 409; when true the create is allowed as a declared
            household member (and such a member is not flagged as a possible duplicate).
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The pet owner's salutation, derived at read time as the title and
                last name separated by a single space (e.g. 'DR Franklin'), or just
                the last name when no title was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the
                stored first and last names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The pet owner's initials as the upper-cased first letters of the
                stored first and last names, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans at read time: the
                country code, a single space, then the national digits grouped in threes
                from the left (e.g. '+61412345678' -> '+61 412 345 678'). The raw
                'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where LAST3 is
                the upper-cased first three letters of the last name and NNNN is a
                global 4-digit zero-padded sequence assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed at read time over the digits
                contained in the owner's customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY
                is the last two digits of the registrationDate year, assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for the owner's household: the first 12 hex
                characters of SHA-256 over the normalized last name and the postcode. It is
                deterministic, so every owner with the same last name and postcode derives
                the same value automatically. Owners created without a postcode have no
                household and no householdId.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived identity key, consolidating all duplicate detection into a
                single value formatted 'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' (the email and
                householdId components are empty when absent). Two owners are the same identity only
                when their whole key matches; a create is rejected with 409 only on an exact
                full-key match.
              type: string
              example: '+616085550002||A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was created,
                already shared the same first name and last name (compared
                case-insensitively). Zero when the name was unique on creation.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, assigned at creation. Start at 0 and
                accumulate: +2 when an email is present, +1 when the owner's namesakeCount

Converted owner deletion to a soft-delete across the endpoint pipeline.

**Domain / persistence**
- `model/Owner.java` — added a `deleted` boolean field (column `deleted`), defaulting to `Boolean.FALSE` so newly created owners are not deleted, with getter/setter.

- `function/owner/DeleteOwner.java` — now sets `deleted = true` and `save`s (retaining the row) instead of `repository.delete(owner)`. The DELETE YAML already responds 204 (2xx) and `GET` still loads the row via `findById`, returning it with `deleted` true.

- `function/owner/AssignPossibleDuplicate.java` — also ignores deleted owners, matching the spec's "non-deleted" wording for the possible-duplicate flag.
